name: Void Augmentation fills Dreadnought's inert cooldown slot and adds jump targets to Eldritch Shock natively (#1184)
contract: 680575 effect0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 23 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (modifies effect-index-2), BasePoints -3001 / DieSides 1 -> value -3000, EffectSpellClassMask dwordB bit10 (1024), which matches Dreadnought (567525)'s own SpellFamilyFlags dwordB bits 0+10 (1025) -- verified from Spell.dbc, not assumed. Dreadnought's own effect-index-2 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, misc 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -1 (baseline value 0, an inert placeholder), EffectSpellClassMask dwordB bit14 (16384) matching Twilight Shieldtoss (804208)'s own SpellFamilyFlags dwordB bit14. This is the same 'talent fills a placeholder effect slot on a different, already-shipped buff spell' pattern as #1165's 680556, and the harness's spell_effect_value metric observes it the same way, via SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's own internal Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers call, independent of any live buff-cast timing. Effect1 of 680575 is aura 107, misc 17 = SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, BasePoints 2 / DieSides 1 -> value 3, EffectSpellClassMask dwordC bit19 (524288), which matches Eldritch Shock (808043)'s own SpellFamilyFlags dwordC bit19 (524288) -- this spell is the live DBC row behind the tooltip's 'Twilight Shock' name (a beta/community tooltip-name drift, not an implementation defect, per the docs/systems/ascension-spell-parity.md Cultist lessons). Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets computes maxTargets = ChainTarget(0) + the SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS flat total, then searches maxTargets-1 additional targets, so a spell_modifier reading of 3 directly proves the tooltip's '2 additional enemies' without needing a live multi-target hit count (avoiding a hit-roll-dependent assertion).

steps.label: SETUP: Dreadnought's cooldown-reduction slot on Twilight Shieldtoss is inert (0)
SETUP: Eldritch Shock has no extra jump targets before the talent
Void Augmentation fills Dreadnought's cooldown-reduction slot with -3000 ms
Void Augmentation adds 3 to Eldritch Shock's jump-target total (2 additional enemies)
